responsibility: Defines the rustc_sanitizers KCFI module boundary and exposes the public API for LLVM Kernel Control Flow Integrity support by re-exporting the type-id configuration and entry points used to compute KCFI identifiers for function ABIs and resolved instances.
same_name_distinction: This top-level `mod.rs` is the public KCFI namespace root, parallel to `cfi/mod.rs`. It only exposes the KCFI `typeid` API; unlike the CFI type-id modules it neither defines the shared option flags nor performs the underlying Itanium encoding, and unlike `kcfi/typeid/mod.rs` it does not compute the final 32-bit KCFI ids.
